text:
Subject: Sync failing again
This is the third time this month the carrier sync has broken. My team has stopped trusting the reports entirely.

Subject: Question about seat limits
Hi, quick question - how do we add two more seats to our plan? Thanks!

Subject: Renewal pricing
Honestly the new pricing feels steep. CompetitorX quoted us 30% less and finance is pushing me to justify every line item.

Subject: Thank you!
The new dashboard saved my team hours this week. Really impressive release.

Subject: Support experience
Your support engineer resolved our issue in twenty minutes. Fantastic service as always.

Subject: Escalation - data loss
We lost a full day of shipment data and nobody has responded to our ticket in 48 hours. This is unacceptable for what we pay.

Subject: API docs
Where can I find the webhook signature documentation?

Subject: Roadmap check-in
Disappointed the EU data residency feature slipped another quarter. It is becoming a blocker for our compliance team.

Subject: Invoice discrepancy
Our invoice shows 120 seats but we only have 100 provisioned. Please correct before we can process payment.

Subject: Great QBR
Really valuable session yesterday - the adoption benchmarks changed how our leadership sees the tool.
